mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 45, indicating a contraction in manufacturing activity, it predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy enters a slowdown or recession.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 45 but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as the UNRATE rising by more than 0.5 percentage points in a month, signals a rapidly weakening labor market and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 1 month but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) both show year-over-year declines of more than 5%, it indicates a broad-based weakening of consumer demand that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST and RSAFS both decline > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3% and the federal funds rate is rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy that will compress S&P 500 valuations and drive negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3% and FEDFUNDS rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over 6 months, with no increase in the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) over the same period, signals a healthy labor market without inflationary pressures that will support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines over 6 months and CPIAUCSL is flat, but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) is above 55 and the federal funds rate is below 2%, it indicates a favorable environment of strong manufacturing activity and accommodative monetary policy that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 55 and FEDFUNDS < 2% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is in a year-over-year decline and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8%, it signals a severe economic downturn that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 decline and UNRATE > 8% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.
